sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:56

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:56:1
items.html:
At first they expanded in the order of three lines: It has already been explained above that the matter of the correction of the lines begins from the force of the illumination of the posterior of Ima (page 528, the passage beginning “And with”). And it is known that AVI of Nekudim came out at first in the phase of back to back, which means that they were corrected by the light of the posterior of the upper Bina, and therefore they were not flawed by the force of the bottom Hey that rose to the Einayim, and they remained in the phase of GAR of Bina, as above (page 498, the passage beginning “Four phases”). This correction is called the correction of three lines, since all three of them — right, left and middle — rise as one, which is the illumination of GAR by the force of the posterior of Bina. They are therefore regarded as bound to one another in a single bond.
One must also understand well the matter of their division into two ends with a deciding line between them, for there is much in it. The matter is that through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, which are Hochma, Malchut was included in each and every Sefira of the ten Sefirot, and therefore a phase of Nukva and of vessel was made in each and every Sefira. It is regarded thereby that there is in every Sefira a phase of right and left, which means Hesed and judgment: for the Sefira itself is the phase of Hesed, and the force of Malchut that was mixed into her through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim is the phase of judgment in the Sefira. Therefore AVI of Nekudim, too, are regarded as right and left, that is, the line of Hesed, which is Hochma and Aba, and the line of judgment, which is Bina and Ima. Now, from the side of these two lines AVI lacked GAR, and therefore the light of the posterior of the upper Bina was drawn to them as a deciding line in their midst. This light of the posterior is regarded as the middle and deciding phase because from its own side there is no distinction whatsoever between right and left, since the entire distinction in the two ends is only because the left, which is the line of judgment, withholds from the right line the light of Hochma that befits it, namely the GAR of Hochma, which it cannot receive because of the mixture of the bottom Hey within it. It is for this reason that they are two ends that contradict one another. However, this line that is drawn from Bina rejects Hochma in any case — that is, even if the phase of judgment were not there — and it is found thereby to stand equally toward both ends together. By this it completes for the right line, which is Hochma, the phase of GAR that it lacks, and it also sweetens the left and joins it with the right in complete unification, since it no longer contradicts it. Thus by the force of the posterior of Ima, which is the phase of the middle line, the two lines, right and left, are bound together and corrected. (See well above, page 528, the passage beginning “And with”)
And this is what he says: “For GAR came out with some correction from the start, meaning that when they first came out, they expanded in the order of three lines.” This is as above, for they came out at first in the correction of back to back, and this correction means the correction of the lines, as above.

items.html: ZAT, which came out one below the other: For ZAT did not come out from AVI from the side of their being in the phase of back to back, but rather they came out from the coupling of face to face of AVI, as above, and therefore there was no bond whatsoever between them; rather, each Sefira was a Guf [body] in its own right: Hesed was the Guf of Aba, Gevura was the Guf of Ima, and so forth. For they lacked the correction of the posterior of Ima, which is the bond that unites all the ends together, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:56:3
items.html: VAK is made in the phase of three lines bound to one another, in the secret of the third line that decides between them: As was explained in the adjacent item, see there. For the beginning of the correction is made in HGT, as above, in the secret of NHY of Ima, and then the NHY too are included in them, in the secret of “and their posterior inward.” Therefore, even afterward, when the posterior is completed also from the side of the illumination of Hochma, still the first correction of the posterior of Ima remains in them, because they come to it from the very beginning of its emanation and it receives no change, for everything that comes from the beginning of the emanation never changes, as is known from the words of the ARI.
